mapper.insert: insert into diydb.reportpost(reportpostId, postCode, title, content, memberId, reporterId, reportedDate) values( null, #{postCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{memberId}, #{reporterId}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') );
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM diydb.reportpost where reporterId = #{reporterId} and postcode=#{postCode} ;
